fields.description: Issue includes local political and legal reporting and commentary. Lead coverage reports City Clerk Harold E. Ross acknowledging an expected audit showing an approximately $12,000 shortage in city clerk accounts, attributed to unpaid municipal court fines, court practices, and professional bondsmen; discussion includes calls for improved procedures and audits. Another major article predicts enforcement action against marble-board gambling devices in Miami, citing City Solicitor Abe Aronovitz and Mayor A. D. H. Fossey. Additional content includes editorials, local gossip/columns, advertisements, sports coverage (baseball, fishing), and a horse-racing tip/service feature.
